deleteUser.metaTitle: How to Delete Your User - T Labs
deleteUser.metaDescription: Learn how to delete your account and all associated data from the T Labs purchasing inventory app.
deleteUser.title: How to Delete Your User
deleteUser.subtitle: We respect your right to privacy. Here's how you can request deletion of your account and all associated data from our purchasing inventory app.
deleteUser.cancelPlanDescription: Before deleting your account, you must cancel your active payment plan. Go to Configurações (Settings) in the mobile app and cancel your subscription under the payment section. Account deletion will not be possible while you have an active plan.
deleteUser.step1Description: Open the mobile application and navigate to Configurações (Settings). You can find it in the bottom menu or the side navigation panel.
deleteUser.step2Description: Inside Configurações, locate and press the "Delete Account" button. You will be asked to confirm your decision before proceeding.
deleteUser.step3Title: We verify and process your request
deleteUser.step3Description: For your security, the app will confirm your identity before processing the deletion. You may be asked to re-enter your credentials to proceed.
deleteUser.step4Description: Once verified, we will permanently delete your account and all associated data, including purchasing history, inventory records, and personal information. This action cannot be undone.
deleteUser.timelineTitle: Your request will be processed within 7 business days
deleteUser.timelineDescription: You will receive a confirmation email once your data has been fully deleted. During this period, your account may be deactivated while deletion is being processed.
deleteUser.privacyDescription: We are committed to protecting your personal data. We do not sell or share your information with third parties. Once deletion is complete, your data is permanently removed from our systems and cannot be recovered.
